display_name: Restart a tracked MCP bridge subprocess (macOS plugin)
description: macOS implementation of restart_bridge: composes terminate + spawn under the same agent_instance_id. Used by the FSEvents watcher on `<solet>.bridge.port` change and by the iTerm2 plugin's restart_session. Bound-provider skip semantics mean callers should route through service_interface::coding_agent_session_service::restart_bridge instead of this plugin::* key.
embedding_description: macOS-side restart of a tracked MCP bridge subprocess — terminate then re-spawn preserving the agent_instance_id binding. Mirrors the canonical service_interface::coding_agent_session_service::restart_bridge contract. Returns BridgeRestartResult.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: BridgeRestartResult frozen dataclass mirroring the canonical service interface return.
